sources.label: Independent Morphe patches for Discord: attachment file sizes, custom voice mess
sources.author: Venus
patch_list: Account switcher
Switch between multiple Discord accounts from the You tab, your profile bar or Settings.
Complete Quests automatically
Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.
Copy profile bios
Hold a bio to select and copy it.
Custom branding
Installs Venus as its own app next to the normal Discord app, with the name, color and icon you pick. It starts signed out and keeps its own settings. Notifications work in both.
Custom themes
Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.
Disable advertising identifiers
Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.
Disable analytics
Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.
Disable crash reporting
Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.
Disable install attribution
Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.
Disable telemetry and touch logging
Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.
Double-tap to reply
Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.
Favourite any image or video
Star any image or video to keep it in your GIF favourites.
Fix unknown mentions
@unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.
Hide the call button
Removes Call from people's profiles. Message fills the space.
Hide the gift button
Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.
Hide the Quests banner
Removes the Quest promotion above your profile bar. Quests still work.
Hide typing indicator
Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.
Icon packs
Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.
Jump to first message
A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.
Keep deleted messages
Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.
Message highlights
Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.
Pastel name colors
Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.
Read all button
A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.
Send audio as voice messages
Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.
Send long messages
Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.
Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.
Server info
Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.
Show device indicators
Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.
Show file sizes when attaching
Photos and videos in the picker show their size.
Show hidden channels
Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.
Skip delete confirmation
Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.
Spaces in channel names
Shows "general chat" instead of "general-chat".
Translate messages
Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.
Unlock app icons
Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.
Use your phone's emojis
Your phone's emojis instead of Discord's, in chat, reactions and the emoji picker.
Use your phone's font
Replaces Discord's font (gg sans) with your phone's, everywhere. Android 9 or newer.
User activity notifications
Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.
User and server reviews
Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).
Venus button on profile bar
A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.
Venus settings
Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.

sources.label: Morphe patches hiding Discord's quest promo banner
sources.author: Discord
patch_list: Hide gift button
Hides the gift button in the chat message composer.
Hide quest promo banner
Hides the quest promo banner at the top of the server channel list.
Pin app to built-in bundle

Forces Discord to always run the bundle inside the APK and ignore downloaded (OTA) updates, which would otherwise silently undo the other patches. Turn this off (or update the APK) to receive official updates.
